objective: Repair exact candidate 0ae583ef through shared exact-instant, finite-number, iterative-lineage, and symlink-safe provenance primitives; close all eight manager counterexamples and every later exact-candidate independent-rereview finding before the KGI/KPI control plane can be decision-grade.

risk.rationale: This control plane determines completion, throughput, quality, continuity, provider routing, and cost policy; accepting float-collapsed time, non-finite numbers, cyclic lineage, unsafe paths, or self-recomputable final evidence would multiply incorrect decisions across later development.

Run Cargo, product builds, install, demo, dogfood, broad product Python suites, or network calls

Extend a due date, recompute a checksum, or rewrite an old final record merely to make validation pass
Claim decision-grade finality when required Git provenance is uncommitted, shallow, exported, or unavailable
Edit independent reports, task packets, result/design evidence, issue state, product source, or user-owned worktree changes

non_goals: Change CodeFire product behavior or CFR-168 product candidates
Review the devcontainer, CI, packaging, host resources, or agent-wrapper implementation
Fabricate a five-packet baseline, evidence, provider cost, KGI achievement, or refreshed lifecycle date

invariants.statement: Every contract instant is ordered as integer nanoseconds and no post-boundary event can compare equal through floating-point collapse.
invariants.falsification_test: Place events one nanosecond before and after capture, recompute a one-nanosecond interval, and require literal-oracle ordering and value.

invariants.statement: Only finite JSON numbers excluding booleans can enter schema, semantic, canonical-hash, or measurement arithmetic paths.
invariants.falsification_test: Inject NaN and both infinities through JSON and direct-object routes at every numeric position and require stable intended findings without crashes.

invariants.statement: Every candidate and record-version lineage is one rooted acyclic graph validated iteratively with monotone readiness.
invariants.falsification_test: Inject two- and three-node cycles beside a valid root, dangling and duplicate nodes, cross-batch supersession, and reversed readiness; each must fail.

invariants.statement: One injected validation instant enforces active and in-progress due dates while freshness comparisons remain isolated by batch.
invariants.falsification_test: Validate due minus one nanosecond, due, and due plus one nanosecond across active/in-progress/final states and cross-batch newest records.

invariants.statement: Repository documents, flow records, context artifacts, and agent locators preserve the raw subject and cannot traverse symlinks or non-normalized components.
invariants.falsification_test: Use final/intermediate/broken external symlinks and paths containing dot, dot-dot, empty, leading, doubled, or trailing components; each must fail closed.

invariants.statement: A final record is decision-grade only when its current raw bytes equal the first committed final blob for that exact version in current HEAD ancestry.
invariants.falsification_test: Recompute the content checksum after worktree and committed rewrites, use unavailable history, and require failure; preserve old bytes while adding a valid superseding version.

invariants.statement: All 55 semantic reversals closed by the candidate remain rejected with stable intended findings after shared primitives are repaired.
invariants.falsification_test: Rerun the complete original semantic matrix and the eight manager counterexamples against the repaired candidate and exact rejected candidate.

validation.purpose: Exercise exact-time, finite-number, graph, lifecycle, path, provenance, and the original semantic regression matrix.
Validate all repository AI contracts and the factual active flow record.
Run the bounded aggregate AI-development gate after semantic and provenance repair.
Keep policy, schema, exemplar, lifecycle, indexes, Phase-2 record, and history consistent.
